title: Medicare Out-of-Pocket Exposure
description: Medicare out-of-pocket exposure modeler for a declared plan year: walks a modelled year of utilisation through the Part A benefit-period cost-sharing rules, the Part B deductible and coinsurance and the Part D deductible-then-coinsurance walk, then reports the residual left after a coverage structure (Original Medicare only, Medigap Plan G, Medigap Plan N, or Medicare Advantage), annual premiums including the Part B IRMAA tier and the Part D income-related adjustment, and a routine / rough / worst-case spread. Integer US cents throughout with exact round-half-up basis-point division; the plan year is an input and the node reads no clock. Rejects out-of-domain inputs, including an income tier outside 0-5, with named errors rather than clamping; Plan G and Plan N carry no annual ceiling; the worst-case spend multiplier is an optional input (default 4). Verify-only: it does not price any actual plan and does not assert that any real enrollee's bill is correct.

plan_year.description: Medicare plan year whose published cost-sharing parameters apply. The node reads no clock; an undeclared plan_year is a named domain error, never a silent fallback. Declared: 2026.

coverage_structure.description: Which coverage the residual is measured against. OriginalOnly keeps every dollar of Part A and Part B cost sharing; PlanG and PlanN cover Part A and Part B coinsurance and carry no annual ceiling; Advantage applies the plan coinsurance against the plan in-network maximum out-of-pocket.

irmaa_tier.description: Income-related monthly adjustment tier, 0-5 (six bands in the CMS 2026 Part B fact sheet). Any other value is a named domain error, never coerced.

benefit_periods.description: Non-negative integer count of Part A benefit periods in the modelled year. A benefit period renews after 60 consecutive days with no inpatient hospital or SNF stay. Zero means no admission at all, which also waives the Part A deductible.

days_per_period.description: Non-negative integer inpatient days per benefit period: days 1-60 sit under the Part A deductible, 61-90 at the one-fourth deductible coinsurance, 91-150 at the one-half lifetime-reserve rate, and days after 150 get no Medicare payment and are not costed here.

snf_days.description: Non-negative integer skilled nursing facility days per benefit period: days 1-20 are covered in full, days 21-100 carry the daily coinsurance, and days 101 and beyond get no Medicare payment and are not costed here.

part_b_approved_charges_cents.description: Non-negative integer cents: Medicare-approved Part B charges for the year (physician, outpatient, imaging, therapy, durable medical equipment). The annual Part B deductible is satisfied first, then coinsurance applies to the remainder.

annual_drug_cost_cents.description: Non-negative integer cents: annual gross covered Part D drug cost. The deductible phase pays 100 percent, the initial-coverage phase pays the standard coinsurance, and the walk is capped at the plan-year out-of-pocket threshold.

part_d_deductible_cents.description: Non-negative integer cents: the plan's Part D deductible. A value above the plan-year statutory maximum is clamped to that maximum and the clamp is reported in part_d_deductible_clamped, never silent.

supplemental_monthly_premium_cents.description: Non-negative integer cents: Medigap or Medicare Advantage monthly premium, charged for all twelve months. Zero means no supplemental coverage premium.

advantage_moop_cents.description: Non-negative integer cents: the Medicare Advantage plan's in-network maximum out-of-pocket for Part A and B services. Zero is treated as not entered: medical exposure is shown uncapped and the ADVANTAGE_MOOP_NOT_ENTERED flag is raised. Part D spending is outside the MOOP and is added separately.

advantage_coinsurance_pct.description: Integer 0-100: the Medicare Advantage plan's medical coinsurance percentage, applied to Part A cost sharing plus post-deductible Part B charges. Only read on the Advantage structure; still declared required because every declared input is unconditionally dereferenced.

worst_case_spend_multiplier.description: Optional modelling assumption (default 4): the worst-case scenario multiplies Part B charges and drug cost by this integer. Not a CMS figure; absent or null takes 4. Outside 1-100 is a named domain error.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_medicare_oop_exposure
mcp_tool_definition.description: Medicare out-of-pocket exposure modeler for a declared plan year: Part A benefit-period cost sharing, Part B deductible and coinsurance, Part D cost sharing after the plan-year cap, the residual left after a coverage structure, annual premiums including IRMAA, and a routine / rough / worst-case spread. Integer US cents, no clock, named refusals, optional worst-case multiplier.

output_schema.description: output_payload: plan_year, coverage_structure, irmaa_tier, valid_input, domain_errors[], routine/rough/worst each {part_a_inpatient_cents, part_a_snf_cents, part_b_total_cents, part_d_total_cents, medical_oop_cents, annual_ceiling_cents (number|null), premiums_cents, total_oop_excluding_premiums_cents, total_with_premiums_cents, monthly_budget_cents, reserve_days_consumed, reserve_days_beyond_pool, unlimited_days_flag, snf_beyond_max_flag, moop_fallback_flag}, exposure_spread_cents, unlimited_exposure, part_d_deductible_input_cents, part_d_deductible_effective_cents, part_d_deductible_clamped, parameters_used (the plan-year parameter block actually applied), model_assumptions_used, regulatory_basis, scope_note, and warnings[] (mirror of compliance flags), usd_view{...} for display. All *_cents members are integer US cents.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: plan_year, coverage_structure, irmaa_tier, benefit_periods, days_per_period, snf_days, part_b_approved_charges_cents, annual_drug_cost_cents, part_d_deductible_cents, supplemental_monthly_premium_cents, advantage_moop_cents, advantage_coinsurance_pct. Every property carries a real JSON Schema type read off the kernel's validation path. All twelve are listed required because the kernel dereferences every one of them unconditionally in validate() (an absent member produces a named domain error rather than a default), plus the optional worst_case_spend_multiplier (read with null-as-absent, not required), and advantage_moop_cents / advantage_coinsurance_pct are required for the same reason even though only the Advantage branch consumes their values. mcp_tool_definition.inputSchema is byte-identical to input_schema, as in art-704.
constants_not_inputs: The plan-year parameters (Part A deductible and coinsurance, lifetime reserve days, SNF coinsurance and day counts, Part B deductible and coinsurance rate, Part D maximum deductible, out-of-pocket threshold and standard coinsurance, Part B IRMAA tier premiums, Part D income-related adjustments) and the modelling assumptions (Plan N $20 visit copay, $250 average visit charge, worst-case 2 periods / 30 days / 60 SNF days) are named literals; the worst-case spend multiplier (default 4) is an optional input in the kernel, keyed by plan_year, not policy parameters.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.regulatory_basis: SSA 1813(a)(1)(A) Part A deductible; 1813(a)(1)(A) one-fourth coinsurance days 61-90; 1813(a)(1)(B) one-half coinsurance lifetime reserve days; 1813(a)(3) one-eighth SNF coinsurance days 21-100; SMA 1853(b)(1) Part B 20 percent after the annual deductible; SSA 1860D-2(b)(1) Part D deductible; 1860D-2(b)(4)(B) Part D annual out-of-pocket threshold; 42 CFR 422.100(f)(4) Medicare Advantage in-network MOOP; NAIC Model Regulation 651 sec. 9.1E(11) Plan N copayments.
output_example.scope_note: Verify-only recomputation of Medicare cost sharing for a modelled year of utilisation. It does not track a real enrollee, does not price any actual plan, does not decide enrollment, and does not model Part B excess charges above the Medicare-approved amount, non-covered services, premiums other than Part B, Part D base premium, or any cost beyond day 150 / day 100 of SNF care. Estimate only -- not an official CMS, SSA or plan communication, and not financial, legal or tax advice.
